from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Emu, Pt
path = "/home/user/Desktop/stanford-nlp-seminar-talk-v2.pptx"
prs = Presentation(path)

def describe(slide, n):
    print("="*80)
    print("SLIDE", n)
    for sh in slide.shapes:
        print(" SHAPE name=%r type=%s ph=%s L=%s T=%s W=%s H=%s" % (
            sh.name, sh.shape_type,
            (sh.placeholder_format.idx, str(sh.placeholder_format.type)) if sh.is_placeholder else None,
            sh.left, sh.top, sh.width, sh.height))
        if not sh.has_text_frame: continue
        tf = sh.text_frame
        bp = tf._bodyPr
        print("    bodyPr:", bp.get('anchor'), "autofit:", [c.tag.split('}')[1] for c in bp], "insets:", bp.get('lIns'), bp.get('tIns'), bp.get('rIns'), bp.get('bIns'))
        for pi, p in enumerate(tf.paragraphs):
            pPr = p._pPr
            marL = pPr.get('marL') if pPr is not None else None
            indent = pPr.get('indent') if pPr is not None else None
            lvl = p.level
            bullet = None
            if pPr is not None:
                for c in pPr:
                    t = c.tag.split('}')[1]
                    if t in ('buChar','buNone','buAutoNum'):
                        bullet = (t, c.get('char'), c.get('typeface'))
            runs = []
            for r in p.runs:
                f = r.font
                col = None
                try:
                    if f.color and f.color.type is not None:
                        col = str(f.color.type)+":"+str(f.color.rgb if f.color.type==1 else f.color.theme_color)
                except Exception as e: col = "err"
                runs.append((r.text[:60], f.name, f.size.pt if f.size else None, f.bold, f.italic, col))
            if not runs and not p.text.strip(): 
                print("      p%d lvl=%d align=%s marL=%s indent=%s bullet=%s (EMPTY)" % (pi,lvl,p.alignment,marL,indent,bullet))
                continue
            print("      p%d lvl=%d align=%s marL=%s indent=%s bullet=%s lnSpc=%s" % (pi,lvl,p.alignment,marL,indent,bullet, pPr.find('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}lnSpc') is not None if pPr is not None else None))
            for rr in runs: print("         run:", rr)

for n in [2,3,4,5,6,7,16,17]:
    describe(prs.slides[n-1], n)
`;

    return out

def fix_title_sp(sp, geom, old_sz, new_sz):
    # geometry
    sp = re.sub(r'<a:off x="\d+" y="\d+"/>', '<a:off x="%s" y="%s"/>' % (geom[0], geom[1]), sp, count=1)
    sp = re.sub(r'<a:ext cx="\d+" cy="\d+"/>', '<a:ext cx="%s" cy="%s"/>' % (geom[2], geom[3]), sp, count=1)
    # bodyPr -> old deck's
    sp = re.sub(r'<a:bodyPr\b[^>]*?/>', BODYPR, sp, count=1)
    sp = re.sub(r'<a:bodyPr\b.*?</a:bodyPr>', BODYPR, sp, count=1, flags=re.S)
    # centre every paragraph
    sp = re.sub(r'<a:pPr(?![^>]*algn=)([^>]*?)/>', r'<a:pPr algn="ctr"\1/>', sp)
    sp = re.sub(r'<a:pPr(?![^>]*algn=)([^>]*?)>', r'<a:pPr algn="ctr"\1>', sp)
    if '<a:pPr' not in sp:   # paragraph with no pPr at all
        sp = sp.replace('<a:p>', '<a:p><a:pPr algn="ctr"><a:buNone/></a:pPr>')
    # font size
    if new_sz:
        sp = sp.replace('sz="%s"' % old_sz, 'sz="%s"' % new_sz)
    return sp

report = {}
for n in range(18, 25):
    p = os.path.join(WORK, 'ppt/slides/slide%d.xml' % n)
    d = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()
    orig = d
    ch = []

    # ---- 1. font family: Manrope* -> Gill Sans ----
    d, c1 = re.subn(r'typeface="Manrope[^"]*"', 'typeface="%s"' % OLD_FONT, d)
    if c1: ch.append('font x%d' % c1)

    # ---- 2. body/bullet grey 595959 -> black 000000 ----
    d, c2 = re.subn(r'val="595959"', 'val="000000"', d, flags=re.I)
    if c2: ch.append('grey->black x%d' % c2)

    # ---- 3. title placeholder geometry / size / centring ----
    sps = split_sps(d)
    newd = []; last = 0; tfix = 0
    for (a, b) in sps:
        sp = d[a:b]
        if '<p:ph type="title"' in sp:
            if n == 18:
                sp2 = fix_title_sp(sp, DIVIDER_GEOM, None, None)   # keep 36pt
            else:
                sp2 = fix_title_sp(sp, TITLE_GEOM, '2500', '3000')
            if sp2 != sp: tfix += 1
            newd.append(d[last:a]); newd.append(sp2); last = b
    newd.append(d[last:])
    d = ''.join(newd)
    if tfix: ch.append('title sp fixed')

    # ---- 4. citations 7pt black -> 6pt blue underlined (deck convention) ----
    if 'sz="700"' in d:
        def cite(m):
            t = m.group(0)
            t = t.replace('sz="700"', 'sz="600"')
            t = re.sub(r'val="000000"', 'val="0000ff"', t)
            if 'u="sng"' not in t:
                t = t.replace('<a:rPr ', '<a:rPr u="sng" ', 1)
                t = t.replace('<a:endParaRPr ', '<a:endParaRPr u="sng" ', 1)
            return t
        d, c4 = re.subn(r'<a:(?:rPr|endParaRPr)\b[^>]*sz="700"[^>]*>(?:.*?</a:(?:rPr|endParaRPr)>)?', cite, d, flags=re.S)
        d = d.replace('sz="700"', 'sz="600"')
        ch.append('citations x%d' % c4)

    # ---- 5. slide-number placeholder ----
    if 'type="sldNum"' not in d:
        ids = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'<p:cNvPr id="(\d+)"', d)]
        nid = max(ids) + 500 + n
        d = d.replace('</p:spTree>', SLDNUM.format(id=nid, idx=SLDNUM_IDX[n], fid='{1D2B5A3E-4C6F-4A1B-9E8D-%012d}' % n) + '</p:spTree>')
        ch.append('sldNum added')

    open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(d)
    report[n] = ch
    print('slide %d: %s  (%d -> %d bytes)' % (n, ', '.join(ch), len(orig), len(d)))

# ---- repackage ----
if os.path.exists(OUT): os.remove(OUT)
zf = zipfile.ZipFile(OUT, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for name in names:
    zf.write(os.path.join(WORK, name), name)
zf.close()
print('WROTE', OUT, os.path.getsize(OUT))
